fixed.summary: Added package-private StandardErrors.statusOr(Throwable, int fallback) as the single classification (HttpException -> status(), unwrapped BodyTooLargeException -> 413, else fallback). statusOf(e) is now statusOr(e, 500); FinalHandler uses statusOr(error, response.statusCode()) and keeps the 400-599 clamp. A fallback parameter was used instead of a -1 sentinel so even an HttpException subclass overriding status() behaves exactly as before. Dropped FinalHandler's now-unused HttpException/BodyTooLargeException imports. No public signature changed.

Moved the depth-bounded (64) overrunInChain helper to JsonBodyAcceptanceTest as a public static method (cross-package, like TextCodec); IR_HTTP_011_AC4 now uses it instead of its unbounded loop, and JsonBodyReaderTest static-imports it in place of its private copy. Assertion messages unchanged.

Extracted assertOverrunIs413ThroughOnErrorAndTheAccessLog(JsonCodec), which does the shared setup and asserts status 413, seen.size()==1, e.status()==413, e.code()==PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE and exactly one 'POST /b 413 ' access-log line, and returns the HttpException. The wrapping test still asserts overrunInChain(e) on the returned exception. Test names and AC comments unchanged.

The routerError BodyTooLargeException branch comment now says the branch must stay before isStoreFailure, because BodyTooLargeException is an IOException and would otherwise be answered 503 as a store failure. The FND-001 code is unchanged.
